data.narrative:
Flamefront Propulsion is a pre-seed stage frontier-tech company in the Defense & Security sector, founded by Matt Garcia (MIT aeronautics background; former founding engineer and head of propulsion at Mach Industries). The valuation exercise draws from a comp universe of 10 private firms and 2 public companies operating in Defense & Security. Notable private peers include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems. Public comparables are DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

Peer-median valuation methods proved inapplicable to this analysis. The Defense & Security sector contains 23 same-sector peers overall, but filtering for identical stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier yielded insufficient datapoints (0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier matches; threshold requires ≥3). Applying an all-sector median would introduce material bias given the narrow applicability of the filtered set.

Without triangulated results from standard comparable-company methods, this valuation remains anchored to disclosed cap table and fundraising milestones rather than quantitative peer benchmarks. Key uncertainties include the absence of stage-specific Defense & Security comparables and lack of disclosed prior funding or current valuation. Progression through seed-stage funding events and clearer commercial traction milestones will improve the precision of future valuation rounds.
